rawDiagnostics.ruleName: Complex Logic in Angular Component Constructor
rawDiagnostics.message: Non-trivial logic in component constructor; move it to ngOnInit or a well-named method.
rawDiagnostics.remediation: Move non-trivial initialization out of the constructor and into ngOnInit or a dedicated, well-named method called from ngOnInit; reserve the constructor for dependency injection and simple field assignment. Evidence: Angular official coding style guide -- https://angular.dev/style-guide (recommends avoiding long or complex logic directly in constructors/lifecycle hooks, preferring well-named methods called from them; corroborated independently across the style guide's constructor and lifecycle-hook guidance).
